messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences that state this fact in your own words, without copying its phrasing (use the two names exactly): Geki Mazera owns Sepa Z82

response: Geki Mazera holds ownership of Sepa Z82. The company's title to that asset is recorded under Geki Mazera's name.
